# THRUSTER

> THRUSTER is a Web3 marketplace on the TON blockchain. Customers buy clothing and book hotels and pay with TON, USDT, BNB, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana or INR. Purchases and hotel bookings earn NFT rewards.

## Pages
- [Shop clothing](https://www.thruster.in/products): browse and buy products
- [Book hotels](https://www.thruster.in/services): search hotels and book with crypto or INR
- [Home](https://www.thruster.in/): overview of payments and NFT rewards

## Payments
- Crypto: TON, USDT (TON, TRON, BNB Chain), BNB, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana
- INR via Cashfree
- Wallet connection through TonConnect (Tonkeeper, MyTonWallet)
